Ships a ready-to-use adapter for DeepSeek Harness (DSH)."},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# MosaicMemoryCompress"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"**A generic, pluggable stateless dialogue compression algorithm** — works
with any LLM agent framewo"},{"id":"p3s2","text":"rk, and ships a ready-to-use adapter module for
**DeepSeek Harness (DSH)**."},{"id":"p4s1","text":"LLM conversations grow linearly. MosaicMemoryCompress keeps them bounded — automatically, invisibly,"},{"id":"p4s2","text":" and without the user ever knowing what a "Session" is."},{"id":"p5s1","text":"## How It Works"},{"id":"p6s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"**Steady state: constant message count** — `2 + heavyStart × (messages per round)`, e.g. 62 messages"},{"id":"p7s2","text":" (31 user rounds) for pure two-message rounds, whether at round 60 or round 15,000 (higher, but stil"},{"id":"p7s3","text":"l constant, when tool-call rounds add messages). The compression ratio approaches 100%."},{"id":"p8s1","text":"## Philosophy: Alive Memory, Not a Handover Brief"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"The industry-standard answer to unbounded conversations is threshold
summarization: when the window "},{"id":"p9s2","text":"fills up, summarize everything into one brief
and hand it to a fresh model. The conversation looks l"},{"id":"p9s3","text":"ike it continues. But
structurally it is *amnesia followed by reading a diary*:"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"- **A switch moment.** Memory breaks, then is rebuilt from a single summary call.
- **Indiscriminate"},{"id":"p10s2","text":" loss.** The freshest instructions are paraphrased too — the
exact part that must stay vivid. In a c"},{"id":"p10s3","text":"ontrolled A/B experiment the brief
paraphrased the user's latest instruction and silently dropped an"},{"id":"p10s4","text":" action
item ("write the key points into MEMORY").
- **Invisible loss.** The next model cannot know "},{"id":"p10s5","text":"what the brief omitted, so it
cannot compensate."},{"id":"p11s1","text":"MosaicMemoryCompress models the opposite: biological forgetting. A human does not
remember round 3 o"},{"id":"p11s2","text":"f a 300-round conversation — they keep the lesson, the
rules, the relationship. The algorithm reprod"},{"id":"p11s3","text":"uces that curve inside one
message array:"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"No switch moment, no reset, no length limit. The heavy zone is *semantic
memory* (rules that must ne"},{"id":"p13s2","text":"ver be forgotten); the middle is recent episodic
memory; the raw zone is the vivid present. Loss is "},{"id":"p13s3","text":"**visible**: the zone
structure tells the model what it no longer knows, so it can fetch detail
from"},{"id":"p13s4","text":" shadowed storage on demand."},{"id":"p14s1","text":"| | Threshold summarization (industry) | MosaicMemoryCompress |"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"| Metaphor | amnesia + diary | continuous vivid memory |
| Continuity | resets on every compaction |"},{"id":"p15s2","text":" never resets |
| Loss | indiscriminate, invisible | graduated, visible |
[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"## Features"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"- **Stateless & repeatable** — no session state; call it every turn, and the output can be fed back "},{"id":"p17s2","text":"in as input
- **Zero-cost below threshold** — returns immediately if no compression is due
- **Anti-"},{"id":"p17s3","text":"jitter** — compression only at configurable window boundaries
- **LLM-agnostic** — bring your own `c"},{"id":"p17s4","text":"allLLM` function for Heavy (OpenAI, Anthropic, local models…); light runs zero-LLM
- **DeepSeek Harn"},{"id":"p17s5","text":"ess (DSH) adapter** — ships with `dsh-module/` for seamless integration; the core algorithm stays fr"},{"id":"p17s6","text":"amework-agnostic
- **Tool-call safe** — tool messages don't break round counting
- **Graceful degrad"},{"id":"p17s7","text":"ation** — LLM failures don't block the conversation"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"## Architecture Boundaries"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"MosaicMemoryCompress is intentionally **stateless and lossy**:"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"- **Durable storage is the host's responsibility.** The library compresses
the message array in plac"},{"id":"p20s2","text":"e and never persists original payloads. Hosts
that need lossless history must archive the raw messag"},{"id":"p20s3","text":"es themselves —
through their own code, a database, or the host platform's persistence
layer (the `o"},{"id":"p20s4","text":"nCompress` callback hands every compressed-away original to
the host for archiving).
- **Compression"},{"id":"p20s5","text":" is lossy by design.** Like any summarization approach, early
details fade progressively. That is th"},{"id":"p20s6","text":"e point: the goal is an unbounded
conversation, not lossless archival. If exact retrieval of early t"},{"id":"p20s7","text":"urns
matters, pair this library with a persistence layer and re-read on demand."},{"id":"p21s1","text":"### DSH compatibility"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"> **⚠️ DSH 0.1.5 and newer: use the built-in compaction, do not mount this
> adapter.**
>
> The stoc"},{"id":"p22s2","text":"k `compaction-basic` backend in 0.1.5 already implements this
> adapter's **core logic**: the recent"},{"id":"p22s3","text":" window stays verbatim (default = 16% of
> the window — 160k tokens on a 1M window) and everything o"},{"id":"p22s4","text":"lder folds into
> **one** bounded checkpoint, on a pressure trigger that never interrupts the
> conv"},{"id":"p22s5","text":"ersation. It adds overflow recovery, a durable lock, a full
> `compaction/start|summary|end` transac"},{"id":"p22s6","text":"tion, replay-stability checks and a
> KV-cache-reusing summarization call — a far stronger safety st"},{"id":"p22s7","text":"ory than this
> adapter. The only feature without an official equivalent is the **Light
> zone** (ag"},{"id":"p22s8","text":"e-based, zero-LLM structural dehydration); carrying a second
> compaction engine plus per-version DS"},{"id":"p22s9","text":"H adaptation for that one feature is not
> worth it, and official configuration approximates the sam"},{"id":"p22s10","text":"e effect:
>
